$comment: Pack Rat <data>/scan-blacklist.json v1: the containers scans never open, a JSON list written by the app (GET/POST/DELETE /api/blacklist, app/store/blacklist.mts) and by the game clients' packrat-blacklist.py, which add an entry to the list they read. The app keeps the entries that pass, the first 1000, from a file of at most 256 KiB; its next write leaves the rest out. The scanners and the bridges (adapters/_shared/read_blacklist.py) need only the serial, so they skip any container whose entry has a valid one. Lengths are in UTF-16 units, as the app counts them. Restricted to the keyword subset app/schema/validate.mts supports. The shared cases are app/fixtures/contract-cases/blacklist.json.

where.$comment: where it was: the tile on the ground, or "in <the container it was in>"
